A001.features: Single closed rounded low loop, often less pointed than atlas G19. No descender.

A002.features: Dark low small body after initial looped body; upper blob and lower lobe may be ink pooling or stacked lobes.
A002.reason: Cannot settle visible lobes at source resolution.

A003.features: Low open rounded bowl with entry/exit flourish; resembles trough or open arc.
A003.reason: B crop shows a closed small e-like loop with lower sweep, contrasting adjacent right-open arc. Neither suggested existing family accepted. New-family possibility retained.

A007.features: Short dark form contiguous with preceding crossed stem; low bowl or additional crossed stem may be present.
A007.reason: Joined final group remains uncertain; no fluent segmentation.

A008.features: Tall left-bowl body adjacent to barred left-bowl body; upper cross-stroke association uncertain.
A008.reason: May share preceding bar rather than have own upper horizontal.

U001.features: Tall tangled initial group at line 5 group 9; looped ascender and broad lower flourish, probable one or two cipher bodies.
U001.reason: Upper loop overlaps descender of previous-line oval-return glyph. Lower left bowl and oblique stem may be left-bowl family, but stroke ownership and one/two-body segmentation remain unresolved. Candidate set is diagnostic, no mapping accepted.

R_L01W03B05.reason: Narrow upward oblique stroke meets small angular lower pocket; differs from broad ordinary footed G05 and dark leaf examples. Both pre-key readers diverged. Retain mask.

R_L02W04B05.reason: Left bowl and tall oblique stem visible; upper right short mark may be flourish rather than independent horizontal bar.

R_L02W07B05.reason: Lower contour runs into long underline; return and underline cannot be cleanly attributed.

R_L03W17B01.reason: First left-bowl body joins next; upper bar assignment unclear.

R_L03W11_COUPLED_SPAN.reason: Coupled A/B middle-pair disagreement; independent masks would imply unreviewed cross-combinations. One mask is representation only, not one physical glyph.

spacing.decision: A two-group display retained but B joined five-body group equally supported; not word-boundary evidence.

Source has small gap after single-shoulder initial of W12; grouping not guaranteed lexical.

date.reason: Both graphical records favor V-like lower convergence of right strokes, but shared roof/base and touching ink keep II viable. No calendar-language inference.

finite_followup_experiment.question: Does L05W06 middle closed e-like loop exactly match frozen families?
finite_followup_experiment.method: Original source crop plus ordinary resize; existing card199 exemplar source crops quarter turned. No image enhancement or watermark removal.

findings.G03: No distinct upper short horizontal bar and descending bend like exemplar.
findings.G13: Current body has closed small upper loop and lower sweep; adjacent/source G13 is right-open arc. Equality unproven.
findings.G16: No low open trough with hooks at both ends like exemplar.
findings.G12: Lower sweep is somewhat comparable but upper enclosed loop differs from exemplar upper crook. Equality unproven.
findings.G19: Enclosed area exists but descending lower sweep/foot differs from compact leaf example.

finite_followup_experiment.result: Negative/inconclusive family-equality test. A003 remains UNKNOWN; no new key literal or assigned existing class.
